units.source_text: “你是说驹姐？她真可恨，我不告诉她。”

en.t: Do you mean Koma? She is hateful. I will not tell her.

units.source_text: 叶子这么说过之后，也许是精神松懈下来了，眼睛有点湿润。

en.t: After Yoko said this, perhaps because her tension had eased, her eyes grew a little moist.
She lifted her head and looked up at Shimamura.

units.source_text: 岛村感到有一股奇妙的吸引力，可不知怎地，这样一来，反而燃起了对驹子炽热的爱情。

en.t: Shimamura felt a strange attraction, but somehow this only made his passionate love for Komako flare up all the more.

units.source_text: 他觉得同一个不明身世的姑娘近似私奔地回到东京，也许是对驹子的一种深深的歉意，也是对自己的一种惩罚。

en.t: He felt that returning to Tokyo with a girl of unknown background, almost as if they were eloping, might be a profound apology to Komako and also a punishment for himself.
